calls.title: Rakuten + GrowthBook
calls.summary: Nour Shreim (GrowthBook) discussed with Christian Liebenow (Rakuten) why Rakuten chose Statsig over GrowthBook for experimentation. Key pain points included Statsig’s proactive POC support, custom feature shipping (e.g., Roku tracker), and advanced statistical features like layers, while GrowthBook lacked these and never shared pricing. No immediate next steps were set, but Christian left the door open for future consideration.
